titles.english: The New Adventures of Hutch the Honeybee
titles.native: 昆虫物語　新みなしごハッチ

description:
After another attack by the cruel wasps, the brief period of peace enjoyed in Honeybee land is destroyed. When the queen is killed during the fierce battle, Hutch and his sister Ahya embark on a perilous journey to realize her will to restore order and security to their homeland.

(Source: Tatsunoko Production)
